module

public import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Erdős Problem 546

*References:*
- [erdosproblems.com/546](https://www.erdosproblems.com/546)
- [Su11] Sudakov, B., A conjecture of Erdős on graph Ramsey numbers. Adv. Math. (2011), 3148-3155.
- [AKS03] Alon, N., Krivelevich, M. and Sudakov, B., Turán numbers of bipartite graphs and Ramsey
  graphs of bounded degree. Combin. Probab. Comput. (2003), 477-483.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace Erdos546

/--
Let $G$ be a graph with no isolated vertices and $m$ edges. Is it true that
$$R(G) \leq 2^{O(m^{1/2})}?$$

This is true, and was proved by Sudakov [Su11].

This problem is #11 in Ramsey Theory in the graphs problem collection.
-/
@[category research solved, AMS 5]
theorem erdos_546 : answer(True) ↔
    ∃ C > (0 : ℝ), ∀ (m : ℕ) (V : Type) [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj],
      (∀ v, 0 < G.degree v) →
      G.edgeSet.ncard = m →
      (SimpleGraph.diagonalGraphRamsey G : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ (C * Real.sqrt m) := by
  sorry

-- TODO: Add variants of the problem.

end Erdos546

findings.description: The module bibliography's [Su11] entry gives the page range 3148–3155. Sudakov's cited article appeared on pages 601–609. This is a reference error; the theorem's mathematical statement and attribution are correct.
findings.source_evidence: Sudakov's official publication list, https://people.math.ethz.ch/~sudakovb/papers.html, lists “A conjecture of Erdos on graph Ramsey numbers,” Advances in Mathematics 227 (2011), 601–609.
findings.suggested_fix: Correct [Su11] to: Sudakov, B., A conjecture of Erdős on graph Ramsey numbers. Adv. Math. 227 (2011), 601–609.

findings.description: The module bibliography's [AKS03] entry has the wrong title and page range: it says “Turán numbers of bipartite graphs and Ramsey graphs of bounded degree,” 477–483. The relevant article is “Turán Numbers of Bipartite Graphs and Related Ramsey-Type Questions,” 477–494. Its Conjecture 5.1 does state the problem formalized here.
findings.source_evidence: The published article's first page gives “Turán Numbers of Bipartite Graphs and Related Ramsey-Type Questions,” Combinatorics, Probability and Computing 12 (2003), 477–494, DOI 10.1017/S0963548303005741. Read at https://www.math.ethz.ch/~sudakovb/bipartite-turan-numbers.pdf; also corroborated by Sudakov's publication list and [Su11]'s bibliography.
findings.suggested_fix: Correct [AKS03] to: Alon, N., Krivelevich, M. and Sudakov, B., Turán numbers of bipartite graphs and related Ramsey-type questions. Combin. Probab. Comput. 12 (2003), 477–494.

review.notes: No mathematical misformalization found in Erdos546.erdos_546. Its uniform positive constant and graph hypotheses match AKS03, Conjecture 5.1; Sudakov's Theorem 1.1 proves the stronger explicit bound with C = 250, supporting answer(True) and research solved. The Ramsey definition uses ordinary injective, non-induced copies, and finite vertex types prevent ncard's infinite-set default. Lean experiments in /workspace/review/scratch.lean and boundaries.lean compile without errors: they verify the no-isolated-vertices condition, show that m = 0 forces an empty vertex type with Ramsey number 0, prove R(K₂) = 2, and test small edge counts and degrees. The live erdosproblems.com page remained blocked by Cloudflare despite descriptive User-Agent headers; the original claim and its solution were checked directly in the cited primary papers. Only the two bibliographic slips above require correction.
